request.query: supremum of indices of bounded integer polynomials at reduced rational points

items.name: iSup
items.type: {α : Type u} → {ι : Sort v} → [SupSet α] → (ι → α) → α

items.name: one_le_pow_mul_abs_eval_div
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {a b : ℤ},
  0 < b →
    Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f) ≠ 0 →
      1 ≤ ↑b ^ f.natDegree * |Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f)|

items.name: Polynomial.supDegree_eq_natDegree
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree id p.toFinsupp = p.natDegree

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree_eq_of_max
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A] {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} {b : B},
  b ∈ Set.range D → Function.invFun D b ∈ p.support → (∀ a ∈ p.support, D a ≤ b) → AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p = b
